en.topic_title: Hikers draw scrutiny after entering Hong Kong reservoir spillway during flood discharge for photos
en.topic_summary:
Two hikers have drawn scrutiny after entering the spillway of a reservoir in Yuen Long during a flood discharge and posing for photos, prompting a government department to investigate.



A pair of hikers enter Ho Pui Reservoir’s spillway to take photos. Photo: Screenshot, via Threads.



The Water Supplies Department (WSD) said on Tuesday it was “very concerned” about recent viral social media footage showing two hikers entering the spillway at Ho Pui Reservoir.
